partner_json_extract.why_now: Yango's strongest markets are exactly the gridlocked, water-ringed megacities where a foiling tier delivers the biggest step-change — and where the global ride-hail leaders aren't focused.
partner_json_extract.network_thesis: One app. The under-used coasts and lagoons of MENA and Africa. | Yango owns ride-hail demand across the UAE and Sub-Saharan Africa's fast-growing, gridlocked megacities — and almost all of that demand moves on congested roads beside vast under-used water. The same in-app foiling tier activates the Dubai and Abu Dhabi coast and turns the Lagos lagoon into a congestion-beating transport layer — the water layer of Yango's super-app, where Uber, Bolt and Grab don't lead.
partner_json_extract.multimodal_fit: Yango already routes the road first/last mile; the foiling pier becomes the water node in the same in-app trip across both regions.
partner_json_extract.differentiation: {'why_navier': 'A software-defined, autonomy-ready foiling platform that activates under-used coasts and lagoons with only a berth pedestal — the fastest, cleanest way across exactly the gridlocked, water-ringed megacities where Yango leads.'}
partner_json_extract.the_ask: {'navier_brings': 'The silent foiling fleet, captain training, maintenance and certification path, and the software-defined operating platform.', 'partner_brings': "Yango's ride-hail demand, super-app rails, road feeder network and local market presence across MENA and Africa.", 'together': "A foiling water tier that activates under-used coasts and lagoons as in-app transport across Yango's strongest markets."}
partner_json_extract.close: Yango, on the water. | From the Dubai coast to the Lagos lagoon — a foiling water tier that turns Yango's gridlocked, water-ringed megacities' biggest under-used asset into the fastest way across the city.
